name: v4.0.541
body:
## What's Changed

- [`@remotion/lambda`: Allow custom function names to `deployFunction()`](https://remotion.dev/docs/lambda/custom-function-names) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12849
- `remotion`: Forward Solid data and aria props to its canvas by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12933
- `remotion`: Round fractional `rgb()` channels in `interpolateColors()` by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12912
- `remotion`: Remove broken `requestVideoFrameCallback` time comparison from media sync by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12903
- `remotion`: Avoid replaying HTML5 audio after Player buffering by @keiffff in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12514
- `@remotion/studio`: Add "Render and replace" action to swap a scene for its rendered video by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12839
- `@remotion/lambda-client`: Remove the duplicate bundled `fast-xml-parser` dependency by @gongfpp in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12943
- `@remotion/lambda-python`: Upload input props to the forced bucket by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12854
- `@remotion/media`: Fix Windows hardware decoder stalls with high-fps source videos by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12842
- `@remotion/media`: Call `<Video>` `onError` in client-side rendering and respect disallowed fallbacks by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12901
- `@remotion/media`: Skip rerunning effects on an unchanged decoded video frame by @FTMManager in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12878
- `@remotion/media`: Avoid duplicate animated video effect paints by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12885
- `@remotion/motion-blur`: Render a single sample when the shutter angle is 0 by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12913
- `@remotion/paths`: Fix NaN length of arcs whose radii are scaled up by @b84330808 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12910
- `@remotion/paths`: Cut the closing `Z` command in `cutPath()` by @b84330808 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12921
- `@remotion/renderer`: Gracefully close Chrome to avoid retained macOS code-sign clones by @antidebug in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12804
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix flickering issue on Windows by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12939
- `@remotion/renderer`: Avoid reusing pages of a browser that was replaced after a crash by @yongjip in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12896
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix render hanging forever after a browser crash by @yongjip in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12841
- `@remotion/studio`: Add playback controls to fullscreen preview by @npmisantosh in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12906
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix timeline edits, output paths, and tab restoration by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12931
- `@remotion/studio`: Improve timeline editing, render outputs, captions, and undo/redo by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12875
- `@remotion/studio`: Keep cursors stable throughout drag gestures by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12940
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix trim cursors during marquee selection by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12937
- `@remotion/studio`: Don't show notification after pasting a property onto multiple sequences by @Maxwell-II in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12941
- `@remotion/studio`: Open hosted Studio links without a leading slash by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12926
- `@remotion/studio`: Fall back to `execCommand('copy')` when the Clipboard API is unavailable by @andriidrok1 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12911
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix 1px video seam at the edge of the fitted preview by @Asyncronize in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12877

## Templates

- Vibe Code template: Fix visual editing and browser exports by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12932

## Docs

- Fix hydration errors caused by the SWC HTML minifier by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12930
- Add Karaoke Captions to product resources by @ParishKhan in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12871
- Remove Recorder from Products navbar by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12887

## Internal and Experimental

- [`@remotion/sdk`: Add `getCanvasKeyframeValueChange()` for editing selected keyframes](https://remotion.dev/docs/sdk/get-canvas-keyframe-value-change) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12932
- `@remotion/paths`: Prepare arc tangent direction fix for Remotion 5 by @b84330808 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12868
- `@remotion/promo-pages`: Fix pricing terms links across sites by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12919
- Skills: Add `/fix-root-cause` skill by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12902
- Skills: Add `/no-comments` skill by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12892
- remotion.dev/brand: Add 2020 Remotion prototype podcast edit by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12895
- remotion.dev/brand: Polish agentic video and standardize Dark+ visuals by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/commit/72a13b0872

## New Contributors

- @gongfpp made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12943
- @kevin9327 made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12912
- @npmisantosh made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12906

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/compare/v4.0.540...v4.0.541
